seo.title: Request an Appointment | Valencia Dentistry
seo.description: Request a dental appointment in Valencia, Santa Clarita. Book online in seconds or send your details and we'll confirm a time. New patients welcome.

sections.heading: Book your visit with Dr. Lavi.
sections.lead: Choose a time instantly with online booking, or send a request and we'll confirm the earliest slot that suits you. Same-day appointments are often available.

image.alt: A patient smiling in the dental chair with Dr. Lavi

sections.heading: Ask for a time that suits you
sections.lead: Fill in the form and a member of our team will reach out to confirm your appointment.

sections.heading: From the parking lot to your plan
sections.lead: No rush and no surprises. Here is exactly what to expect when you come in for your new patient exam.

steps.title: Before you arrive
steps.text: We check your PPO benefits ahead of time. Park free on site; Suite 240 is on the second floor, and the building has an elevator.

steps.title: A short health history
steps.text: Arrive a few minutes early with a photo ID, your insurance card and a list of the medications you take.

steps.title: Digital X-rays
steps.text: Low-radiation digital X-rays show what can't be seen in the chair, and appear on screen right away.

steps.title: An unhurried exam with Dr. Lavi
steps.text: Teeth, gums and bite, plus an oral cancer screening. He explains what he sees as he goes.

steps.title: A plan you can take home
steps.text: Your options, what is urgent and what can wait, a written estimate, and time for every question.

sections.note: Your first visit includes a comprehensive exam and X-rays.
